description: Update Sequence Properties and State. Archiving is handled by archive_sequence. Recipients must be the account holder's own contactable audience and suppression/blocklist is always enforced. Changing launch settings to start sending emails must only happen after explicit user confirmation.

bcc.description: BCC email address for all outgoing emails

checkEmailBeforeSending.description: Verify email before sending. When enabled user must approve email before they can be sent

checkEmailClick.description: Check if recipient clicked a link in previous email

checkEmailOpen.description: Check if recipient opened previous email

checkEmailReply.description: Check if recipient replied to previous email

confirm.description: Required when paused is false — confirms the account holder explicitly approved resuming the sequence

emailSendingHours.description: Custom email sending hours for each day of the week (Monday-Sunday). Must include all 7 days if provided.

enabled.description: Whether sending is enabled on this day

folder.description: General folder ID to move the sequence into. Must be a folder created without a type (i.e., not an email-sender folder).

invalidEmail.description: Send to contacts with invalid email status

lists.description: Array of list UUIDs to associate with sequence

paused.description: Pause or resume the sequence. Setting false resumes sending emails to recipients and requires confirm: true as the account holder's explicit approval.

riskyEmail.description: Send to contacts with risky email status

scheduledAt.description: Launch time. UTC milliseconds OR an ISO 8601 datetime with timezone offset, e.g. '2026-07-08T16:30:00+05:30' for 4:30 PM IST.

steps.description: Modify sequence steps. Each email step must be {type: 'email', template_id: 'public-template-uuid'} with optional send_as: 'new' | 'followup' (followup replies in the existing thread; ignored on the first email step, which always starts a new thread). Each delay step must be {type: 'delay', days: number}. When provided, the entire steps array replaces the existing flowchart.

send_as.description: How to send this email: 'new' (default) starts a new thread; 'followup' replies in the lead's existing thread as 'Re: <original subject>'. Ignored on the first email step of the sequence, which always starts a new thread.

template_id.description: Public template UUID for the email step

days.description: Number of days to wait before the next step

stopWhenReplyRecievedWhen.description: When to stop sequence on reply: 'contact' = stop for this contact only, 'contact-with-same-domain' = stop for all contacts sharing the same domain

timezone.description: IANA timezone for sending emails, e.g. 'Asia/Calcutta' or 'America/New_York'

validEmail.description: Send to contacts with valid email status

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID this action applies to. When omitted, the current or default workspace is used.

name: update_sequence

result.description: The raw result returned by the SalesBlink tool.

title: Update Sequence
